answer: Proof of Burn acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain network influence. Unlike a falcon scouting for nodes, this system enforces a non-refundable capital cost, making identity replication economically unsustainable. Whether an agent uses a jade wallet or a juniper-secured node, the attacker must exhaust liquid capital, ensuring that the cost of generating new identities consistently exceeds the potential marginal utility of those fake entities.
